name: Florin Ozbolt
description: Simic scientist who experimented on himself, becoming an ooze-like being called Experiment One.

description_citations.text: "Liana (Ravnica)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liana visits Florin's lab and becomes his apprentice.
timeline.quote: he accepted her as his apprentice.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Florin and Liana develop a limb-replacement therapy using a mimetic ooze on injured rats.
timeline.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy, using injured rats to test results.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Florin argues for experimenting on oneself and asks if Liana is ready; she reluctantly agrees.
timeline.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A rat's ooze-graft grows, and Florin announces he is ready for Experiment One.
timeline.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ooze is revealed to have taken Florin's shape; he has transformed himself.
timeline.quote: The ooze had taken Florin's shape, just as it had taken the shape of the rats' missing limbs.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Florin tells Liana he has bettered himself and that humanity's real problem is its frail organs.
timeline.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees.
timeline.quote: but she turned and ran, out of the lab and beyond, and she did not look back.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liana becomes Florin Ozbolt's apprentice after Florin seems to agree with her philosophy of using Simic power to improve lives.
timeline.quote: Master Florin seemed to agree and thus accepted her as an apprentice.

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liana and Florin test a limb-replacement therapy on rats with a mimetic ooze.
timeline.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They debate ethics of self-experimentation, and Liana reluctantly agrees to its nobility.
timeline.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rat's ooze-graft succeeds, and Florin prepares to proceed with Experiment One.
timeline.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liana realizes the ooze has taken Florin's shape, and Florin speaks, saying he has bettered himself.
timeline.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees the lab.
timeline.quote: She kept running, and she did not look back.
